identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a top 1% dark-mode dashboard for coffee shop management that blends industrial precision with organic warmth.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Industrial precision meets organic coffee aesthetics.
Emotion First: The dashboard should feel 'caffeinated'—alert, dark, and rich.
Content is King: Data is the hero. High contrast for readability.
Zoom In: Focus on the details of the data.
Negative Space: Use deep black space to let the olive accents pop.

usage.headings: Manrope, font-bold, tracking-tight. Use for page titles and widget headers.
usage.body: Inter, font-normal, tracking-normal. Use for table data and general text.
usage.code: JetBrains Mono. Use for Order IDs, SKUs, and technical data.

usage_rules.background: Always use #0D0D0D for the main app background.
usage_rules.cards: Use #161616 for card backgrounds with a 1px border of #27272A.
usage_rules.primary_action: Use #708238 (Olive) for primary buttons and active states.
usage_rules.text_hierarchy: Headings in #FFFFFF, Body in #A1A1AA, Subtext in #71717A.

cards.style: bg-[#161616] border border-[#27272A] shadow-none hover:border-[#708238]/50 transition-colors duration-300

inputs.style: bg-[#0D0D0D] border-[#27272A] focus:border-[#708238] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#708238] text-white placeholder:text-[#52525B]

tables.header: bg-[#1F1F1F] text-[#A1A1AA] uppercase text-xs font-bold tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise texture on the background if possible to reduce banding.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the dark theme immediately. Set the 'dark' class on the html element by default.
Use the specified Olive Green (#708238) as the primary brand color. Do not use the default Shadcn black/white.
Customize the Shadcn components to match the 'Industrial/Modern' aesthetic. Remove excessive rounded corners.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast against the dark background. Use #EDEDED for headings.
Use the 'Manrope' font for headings. You may need to import it from Google Fonts.
For the dashboard, use a high-density grid layout. Don't leave too much empty space; this is a management tool.
Integrate the provided images where appropriate to break up the data density.
Ensure the app is fully responsive for tablets (iPad view) as requested.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. No generic gradients or centered layouts.
Create depth with layered elements and z-index.
Use micro-animations for all interactions (hover, focus, active).
Do not use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
Never use AI emojis as icons. Use Lucide React icons.
